chapter.title: Licensing
chapter.simpara: The project is REUSE-compliant. Licence texts are stored in LICENSES/ using SPDX filenames.
For project-authored files that can carry headers:

listitem.simpara: Set the SPDX License-Identifier to GPL-3.0-or-later.
Use FileCopyrightText to credit Chrysalide Learning and the author.

chapter.simpara: Preserve upstream copyright notices in third-party files. Use REUSE.toml for files that cannot carry headers, such as binaries or Markdown, or for upstream notices that are not REUSE-compliant.
